quests.title: Getting Started
description: Info: Every workshop starts with a little work by hand. Gather your materials and begin crafting the components that will get your factory started.
Tip: Follow the ingredient branches into each crafting milestone. Check JEI whenever you need the exact recipe.
quests.subtitle: Quest Information

quests.title: Gather Clay!
description: Tip: Look for clay in rivers and shallow water. The alloy recipe uses Clay Balls, so keep them loose instead of crafting them back into Clay Blocks.
quests.subtitle: Getting Started

quests.title: Alloying Some Andesite
description: Tip: Gather a few extra logs and keep some uncrafted. Besides making planks, a stripped log can become an Andesite Casing.
quests.subtitle: Getting Started

quests.title: Gather Some Andesite!
description: Tip: This ordinary-looking stone is a key ingredient in Andesite Alloy. Bring a decent supply back from your mining trips; your first mechanisms will use plenty of it.
quests.subtitle: Getting Started

quests.title: Ironing Things Out
description: Tip: Each Makeshift Mechanism uses one Iron Ingot at the center of its recipe. Set some iron aside before spending everything on tools and armor.
quests.subtitle: Getting Started

quests.title: Alloying Some Andesite
description: Info: Combine two Andesite and two Clay Balls to craft one Andesite Alloy.
Tip: Each Makeshift Mechanism uses four Alloy. The next chapter introduces a more efficient mixing recipe.
quests.subtitle: Getting Started

quests.title: Craft Some Slabs!
description: Tip: Each Makeshift Mechanism needs four wooden slabs. Any supported wooden slab will work, so use the wood you already have.
quests.subtitle: Getting Started

quests.title: A Little More Room
description: Tip: You will need the full 3×3 crafting grid for your Makeshift Mechanisms. These must be crafted by hand in a normal Crafting Table.
quests.subtitle: Getting Started

quests.title: Making Do
description: Info: Craft a Makeshift Mechanism by hand using four Andesite Alloy, four wooden slabs and one Iron Ingot.
Tip: These are your manual starting route. Once you can automate Rotation Mechanisms, you can make the same Andesite Machine with fewer materials.
quests.subtitle: Getting Started

quests.title: Chapter Completed
description: Info: You have finished this chapter! Mark this quest as completed, then head over to The Story and claim Chapter I | Completed to unlock Chapter II — Rotations & Andesite.
Tip: Your first mechanisms are only the beginning. Next, it is time to get the workshop turning!
quests.subtitle: Unlock Next Chapter

quests.title: Getting Started
description: Info: Time to put those materials to work! This chapter introduces powered wood processing, milling, washing and mixing, finishing with your first Rotation Mechanism.
Start with a Water Wheel and carry its rotation to your machines using Shafts and Cogwheels. Convert Andesite Machines into the processing blocks you need using a Stonecutter.
Tip: More Water Wheels provide additional stress capacity. To increase speed, have a Large Cogwheel drive a Small Cogwheel. Hold your Ponder key over Create items to see how their machinery works.
quests.subtitle: Quest Information

quests.title: Between a Rock and a Hard Place
description: Info: Cobblestone is the beginning of your mineral processing line. It can be milled into Gravel, then Sand, before washing turns that Sand into Clay Balls.
Tip: A Water and Lava generator gives you a renewable supply. Point a powered Mechanical Drill at the generated block to collect it automatically.
quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: From Little Acorns…
description: Info: Every wood supply starts somewhere. Gather a few Saplings and establish a renewable source of trees near your workshop.
Tip: Leave enough room above and around your saplings to grow. Keep some spare saplings in storage so your next batch of timber is always within reach.
quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: Taking Things for Granite
description: Info: Gather Andesite for your Alloy production. You can also generate it automatically to keep your workshop supplied.
Hover over the Andesite item in this quest's task and hold W to watch the Ponder showing how to build a generator for it.
Tip: The catalyst is not consumed. Replace the Mechanical Drill after changing an existing generator's catalyst so it updates its predicted output.
quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: Hammer Time!
description:
Info: Craft an Iron Hammer. 
Your Deployer will use it to finish each Rotation Mechanism after the Alloy has been applied.
Tip: The Hammer remains in the Deployer, but each completed mechanism uses one durability. Keep an eye on it when running larger batches.
quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: A Little Rough Around the Edges
description: Info: Feed Cobblestone into a powered Millstone to grind it into Gravel. Supply rotation through the Millstone's shaft connection, then insert your materials from above.
Tip: Right-click the Millstone with an empty hand to collect its contents. A Hopper underneath can extract the output for you.

prerequisites.title: Between a Rock and a Hard Place

quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: Timber!
description: Info: Gather some Logs for your growing workshop. Wood supplies your slabs, casings and plenty of the machinery that comes next.
Tip: A powered Mechanical Saw can help with tree cutting as well as processing wood. Check its Ponder scenes before building a larger harvesting setup.
quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: Sand Between Your Gears
description: Info: Run your Gravel through the Millstone to produce Sand. In this pack, milling Gravel is a direct step in your renewable Clay production chain.
Tip: You can reuse your first Millstone for both steps. Once production grows, a second Millstone lets Cobblestone and Gravel processing run together.

prerequisites.title: A Little Rough Around the Edges

quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: Bark Off!
description: Info: Feed an Oak Log over an upward-facing, powered Mechanical Saw to turn it into a Stripped Oak Log. This is the first pass in your wood-processing line.
Tip: You can also strip placed Oak Logs using an Axe. Save some stripped logs for Andesite Casings, and send the rest through the Saw again to produce Oak Planks.
quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: A Clean Start
description: Info: Power an Encased Fan and make it blow through Water. Place Sand in the airflow beyond the Water to wash it into Clay Balls.
Each Sand has three separate 33% chances to produce a Clay Ball, so individual results range from none to three.
Tip: A Depot helps keep the Sand in place. Check the airflow direction: if the fan is pulling air the wrong way, reverse its rotation.
quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: Wood You Look at That!
description: Info: Use a powered Mechanical Saw to get more from your timber. Sawing a Log strips it first; processing the Stripped Log again produces 6 Planks.
Tip: The saw processes items on its upward-facing blade. Collect the stripped wood and feed it through again, or arrange a return path to handle both passes.
quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: Alloying Some Andesite
description: Info: Combine 1 Andesite and 1 Clay Ball in a Basin beneath a powered Mechanical Mixer to produce 1 Andesite Alloy. No heat is required, and this uses half the materials of the manual recipe.
Build the Mixer using a Cogwheel, Whisk and Andesite Machine. The Whisk requires Iron Sheets, which you can make with a Mechanical Press above a Depot.
Tip: A Mixer needs more speed than a Water Wheel supplies directly. Have a Large Cogwheel drive a Small Cogwheel to increase the speed, and add stress capacity if the system becomes overstressed.
quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: Half the Block, Twice the Fun
description: Info: Your next mechanism starts with a humble Wooden Slab. A Mechanical Saw turns each Plank into 2 Slabs, giving you a convenient supply for assembly.
Tip: Set a Wooden Slab in the saw's recipe filter. Planks have multiple cutting recipes, so the filter tells the saw which result you want.
quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: A Turn for the Better
description: Info: Your first assembly sequence starts with a Wooden Slab. Use powered Deployers to perform these steps in order:

1. Apply an Andesite Alloy.
2. Apply another Andesite Alloy.
3. Use the Iron Hammer to finish the mechanism.
The sequence runs once and produces 1 Rotation Mechanism. Build your first Deployer using a Gold Hand and an Andesite Machine. The Gold Hand uses Gold rather than Brass in this pack.
Tip: One Deployer above a Depot is enough to get started: swap its held item as needed between steps. Eight Rotation Mechanisms and an Andesite Casing make another Andesite Machine.

prerequisites.title: Half the Block, Twice the Fun

quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: Case Closed!
description: Info: Every machine needs something to hold it together. Right-click a placed Stripped Oak Log with an Andesite Alloy to turn it into an Andesite Casing.
Tip: Keep some stripped logs aside before sawing the rest into Planks. These Casings are used throughout your early workshop, including in Andesite Machines.
quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: Welcome to the Machine!
description: Info: Surround an Andesite Casing with 8 Makeshift Mechanisms in a Crafting Table to make your first Andesite Machine. Once your assembly setup is running, you can use 8 Rotation Mechanisms around the Casing instead.

This machine body is the starting point for your processing equipment. Use a Stonecutter to turn it into blocks such as Millstones, Mechanical Saws, Encased Fans and Mechanical Drills. Other machines use it directly in their crafting recipes.
Tip: Start with the Makeshift recipe to build the machinery needed for Rotation Mechanisms, then let your new assembly line supply future expansion.
quests.subtitle: Rotations & Andesite

quests.title: Chapter Completed
description: Info: You have finished this chapter! Mark this quest as completed, then head over to The Story and claim Chapter II | Completed to unlock Chapter III — Valves & Fluids.
Tip: Keep your Alloy and Rotation Mechanism production running. Copper, Rubber and fluid processing are up next!
quests.subtitle: Unlock Next Chapter

quests.title: Getting Started
description: Info: Your workshop is ready for its first plumbing project! This chapter brings together Copper, Rubber and Glass to produce the Sealed Mechanism and Copper Machine.
Process Veridium for Copper, extract Resin from trees and turn it into Rubber. Your existing stone-processing line supplies the Sand needed for Glass.
Tip: Your Andesite equipment still has plenty of work to do. Keep those production lines running and leave some room for pipes, fluid storage and the new processing equipment.
quests.subtitle: Quest Information

quests.title: Green Means Copper!
description: Info: This green stone is more than a building material. Veridium can be processed into Crushed Raw Copper, providing a renewable supply for your workshop.
Hover over the Veridium item in this quest's task and hold W to watch the Ponder showing how to build a generator for it.
Tip: The catalyst is not consumed. Replace the Mechanical Drill after changing an existing generator's catalyst so it updates its predicted output.
quests.subtitle: Valves & Fluids

quests.title: Sap Happens!
description: Info: Use a Stonecutter to convert an Andesite Machine into a Sapper from Create: Rubberworks.
Position it facing the trunk of a supported tree and supply rotational power using Cogwheels. The Sapper extracts Resin, which can be pumped out through its back connection.
Tip: Maple trees give the most Sap! Use Biomes O' Plenty Maple trees for a productive Resin supply, and keep their naturally grown leaves intact.
quests.subtitle: Valves & Fluids

quests.title: Another One Bites the Dust!
description: Info: Mill your Gravel into Sand. You already know how to wash it into Clay; this chapter gives it a rather warmer destination.
Tip: Keep the Sand for this branch out of your washing setup. Send it toward smelting instead to produce Glass.
quests.subtitle: Valves & Fluids

quests.title: Copper in the Rough
description: Info: Feed Veridium into a powered Millstone to produce Crushed Raw Copper. Each block produces one piece, ready for smelting.
Tip: Your Millstone is enough to get started. Later, Crushing Wheels improve this route with additional Copper Nuggets and a chance for an Experience Nugget.
quests.subtitle: Valves & Fluids

quests.title: Under Compression
description: Info: Convert an Andesite Machine into a Compressor using a Stonecutter. Supply rotational power from the side and pipe Resin into the back.
Place a lit Campfire beneath the Compressor to provide the required warmth. Each 500 mB of Resin produces 1 Raw Rubber. Collect the output on a Depot or Belt in front of the machine.
Tip: The Compressor must turn clockwise when viewed from its right side. If it has Resin but refuses to work, check both the rotation direction and the heat underneath it.
quests.subtitle: Valves & Fluids

quests.title: Clearly Useful!
description: Info: Smelt Sand in a Furnace to make Glass. You can also bulk-blast it using an Encased Fan blowing through Lava, with the Sand placed in the airflow beyond it.
Tip: Keep some Glass available for fluid storage as well as mechanism assembly. Tanks are useful buffers between your Sapper and Compressor.
quests.subtitle: Valves & Fluids

quests.title: A Copper or Two
description: Info: Smelt your Crushed Raw Copper into Copper Ingots. These supply your Copper Sheets, Casings and fluid pipes.
Tip: An Encased Fan blowing through Lava can bulk-blast suitable items. Place your Crushed Copper in the airflow beyond the Lava to process larger batches.
quests.subtitle: Valves & Fluids

quests.title: A Little More Bounce
description: Info: Your Raw Rubber needs curing before it can be used. Process it in a Smoker, or use an Encased Fan blowing through a lit Campfire to smoke it in bulk.
Each Raw Rubber produces 1 Rubber, ready for your Sealed Mechanisms and other workshop components.
Tip: Rubber also improves your Belt Connector production: three Rubber craft three Connectors, compared with one Connector from three Dried Kelp.
quests.subtitle: Valves & Fluids

quests.title: Belt It Out!
description: Info: Time to get things moving! Craft 3 Rubber into 3 Belt Connectors. The Dried Kelp recipe produces only one Connector from three Kelp, making Rubber a much more efficient choice for expanding your factory.

Tip: Use a Belt Connector on two correctly aligned Shafts to connect them, then supply rotational power. Belts can carry items through pressing, deploying and fan processing, bringing your separate machines together into a production line.
quests.subtitle: Valves & Fluids

quests.title: Flat Out!
description: Info: Place Copper Ingots on a Depot beneath a powered Mechanical Press to flatten them into Copper Sheets. Each Ingot produces one Sheet.
Tip: Keep a supply ready for your Sealed Mechanism assembly. You can start with a Depot and later move pressing onto a Belt as production grows.
quests.subtitle: Valves & Fluids

quests.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered!
description: Info: Start with a Rotation Mechanism and perform these assembly steps in order:

1. Deploy a Copper Sheet.
2. Deploy a Rubber.
3. Deploy a Glass block.
4. Finish with a Mechanical Press.
One complete pass produces 1 Sealed Mechanism.
Tip: A single Deployer can handle the first three steps if you swap its held ingredient between operations. Then move the unfinished mechanism beneath your Press.
quests.subtitle: Valves & Fluids

quests.title: Copper Bottomed!
description: Info: Right-click a placed Stripped Oak Log with a Copper Ingot to make a Copper Casing. It forms the centre of your Copper Machine recipe.
Tip: For automation, a Deployer holding Copper Ingots can apply them to Logs. This pack's Deployer recipe also accepts unstripped Logs.
quests.subtitle: Valves & Fluids

quests.title: Under Pressure!
description: Info: Surround a Copper Casing with 8 Sealed Mechanisms in a Crafting Table to produce a Copper Machine.
This is your next machine body, used to build equipment such as Spouts and Item Drains through Stonecutter conversions.
Tip: Keep your Sealed Mechanism line supplied with Rotation Mechanisms, Copper Sheets, Rubber and Glass. Each additional machine needs another eight mechanisms.
quests.subtitle: Valves & Fluids

quests.title: Chapter Completed
description: Info: You have finished this chapter! Mark this quest as completed, then head over to The Story and claim Chapter III | Completed to unlock Chapter IV — Precision Machinery.
Tip: Leave your Copper, Rubber and Sealed Mechanism production running. Your next workshop upgrades bring Brass and more advanced assembly into the mix!
quests.subtitle: Unlock Next Chapter

quests.title: Precision Machinery
description: Info: Time to give the workshop a little polish! This chapter brings together Golden Sheets, Brass Sheets and Electron Tubes to assemble the Precision Mechanism.
Develop your Gold and Zinc supplies, introduce heated Brass mixing and turn Quartz, Redstone and Iron into electronic components. Your final goal is the Brass Machine.
Tip: Keep your Sealed Mechanism production running. Each Precision Mechanism starts with one, so your earlier workshop still has an important part to play.
quests.subtitle: Quest Information

quests.title: Feeling Blue?
description: Info: This blue stone supplies the other half of your Brass production. Process Asurine into Crushed Raw Zinc, then smelt it into Ingots.
Hover over the Asurine item in this quest's task and hold W to watch the Ponder showing how to generate it.
Tip: Give Asurine its own generator if you want Copper and Zinc production running together. Both metals will be needed for Brass.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Copper Makes a Comeback
description: Info: Your Copper line has another customer! Set aside some Copper Ingots for Brass production while keeping your existing Copper Sheet supply running.
Tip: Split your Copper output before the Press. Brass needs Ingots, while Sealed Mechanisms still need Sheets.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: A Golden Opportunity
description: Info: There is Gold in those yellow stones! Ochrum can be processed into Crushed Raw Gold, giving your workshop a renewable supply.
Hover over the Ochrum item in this quest's task and hold W to watch the Ponder showing how to generate it.
Tip: The catalyst is not consumed. Replace the Mechanical Drill after changing an existing generator's catalyst so it updates its predicted output.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: A Familiar Grind
description: Info: Your Gravel supply has another use. Instead of milling it into Sand, this branch washes Gravel into Crushed Raw Iron for your electronic components.
Tip: Split some Gravel off before the second Millstone. This keeps Iron production running alongside your existing Sand supply.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: A Little Soul Searching
description: Info: Gather Soul Sand from the Nether, or produce it by haunting Sand. An Encased Fan blowing through Soul Fire or a lit Soul Campfire turns Sand placed in the airflow beyond it into Soul Sand.
Tip: Keep the Soul Sand in item form for your next processing step. Washing it will provide the Quartz needed for Electron Tubes.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Seeing Red
description: Info: Your workshop has found another useful stone. Scoria can be milled into Redstone, providing a renewable ingredient for Rose Quartz.
Hover over the Scoria item in this quest's task and hold W to watch the Ponder showing how to generate it.
Tip: Keep your generator's catalyst beneath the Lava source and the normal Create Chute beneath the generated block. Replace the Drill when changing catalysts.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Gold in the Rough
description: Info: Process Ochrum in a powered Millstone to produce Crushed Raw Gold. Each block produces one piece, ready for smelting.
Tip: Once you have Crushing Wheels, this route also produces three Gold Nuggets and has a chance to award an Experience Nugget.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Zinc About It
description: Info: Feed Asurine into a powered Millstone to make Crushed Raw Zinc. Each block produces one piece.
Tip: Crushing Wheels improve this route with three additional Zinc Nuggets and a chance for an Experience Nugget. Your Millstone is enough to get started.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: An Iron in the Wash
description: Info: Wash Gravel using an Encased Fan blowing through Water to produce 1–2 Crushed Raw Iron per item. Each Gravel guarantees one piece, with a 50% chance for a second.
Tip: Collect the washed output and send it toward smelting. A Depot keeps items in place while they are being washed.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Quartz of Course!
description: Info: Wash Soul Sand using an Encased Fan blowing through Water to produce 1–3 Nether Quartz per item. Place the Soul Sand in the airflow beyond the Water.
Tip: You can also mill Diorite into Quartz in this pack. Use whichever supply fits your workshop best.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Dust with Potential
description: Info: Feed Scoria into a powered Millstone to produce 1–3 Redstone per block. Each block guarantees one, with two separate chances for an additional piece.
Tip: Each Rose Quartz needs two Redstone. Keep a small reserve for crafting and controls as well as your component production.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Worth Its Weight
description: Info: Smelt your Crushed Raw Gold into Gold Ingots. Your next assembly line needs Golden Sheets, so these shiny bars have work to do.
Tip: Bulk-blast your Crushed Gold using an Encased Fan blowing through Lava. Place the items in the airflow beyond the Lava to process larger batches.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Everything but the Kitchen Zinc
description: Info: Smelt Crushed Raw Zinc into Zinc Ingots. Combined with Copper, these become the Brass that gives this chapter its shine.
Tip: Brass mixing uses equal numbers of Copper and Zinc Ingots. Keep both supplied so your Basin does not fill up with only one ingredient.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Ironing Things Out
description: Info: Smelt Crushed Raw Iron into Iron Ingots. A Furnace handles your first batches, while fan blasting lets you process larger quantities together.
Tip: Keep part of your Iron supply as Ingots for general crafting. The rest can head to your Press for component production.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Everything’s Coming Up Roses
description: Info: Combine 1 Nether Quartz and 2 Redstone in a crafting grid to produce 1 Rose Quartz. This pack uses a reduced Redstone cost for the recipe.
Tip: The recipe is shapeless, so ingredient placement does not matter. Your Rose Quartz needs polishing before it can become an Electron Tube.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Flattening Your Fortune
description: Info: Place Gold Ingots beneath a powered Mechanical Press to produce Golden Sheets. Each Ingot becomes one Sheet.
Tip: A Depot works well for your first batches. When you automate pressing on a Belt, keep the output feeding your Precision Mechanism assembly.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Getting Down to Brass Tacks
description: Info: Mix 1 Copper Ingot and 1 Zinc Ingot in a Basin using a powered Mechanical Mixer to produce 2 Brass Ingots. This recipe requires heat.
Use an Empty Blaze Burner on a Blaze to capture it. Place the filled Burner beneath the Basin and supply fuel to heat the recipe.
Tip: Check the Burner's fuel and your Mixer's speed if mixing stops. An unfuelled Burner will not provide the heat required for Brass.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Sheet Happens!
description: Info: Press Iron Ingots into Iron Sheets using a powered Mechanical Press above a Depot or Belt. Each Ingot produces one Sheet.
Tip: Each Electron Tube starts with one Iron Sheet. Feed the pressed Sheets directly toward a Deployer holding Polished Rose Quartz when you automate the process.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: A Polished Performance
description: Info: Hold Rose Quartz in your offhand and use Sand Paper in your main hand to polish it into Polished Rose Quartz. Sand Paper can be crafted from Paper and Sand.
Tip: Polishing uses Sand Paper durability. Keep replacements nearby when preparing larger batches of electronic components.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Brass, but Flatter
description: Info: Process Brass Ingots beneath a powered Mechanical Press to produce Brass Sheets. Each Ingot produces one Sheet for your Precision Mechanism assembly.
Tip: Keep some Brass as Ingots for Casings and other recipes. A small buffer before the Press helps prevent everything being flattened.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: A Bright Idea
description: Info: Place an Iron Sheet beneath a powered Deployer holding Polished Rose Quartz. Applying the Quartz produces 1 Electron Tube.
Tip: Both ingredients are consumed. Keep the Sheet on the Depot or Belt and the Polished Rose Quartz in the Deployer's hand.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Like Clockwork!
description: Info: Start with a Sealed Mechanism and perform these assembly steps in order:

1. Deploy a Golden Sheet.
2. Deploy a Brass Sheet.
3. Deploy an Electron Tube.
One complete pass guarantees 1 Precision Mechanism. The final deployment completes it; no pressing step is required.
Tip: For a compact assembly line, place the three Deployers directly beside one another above a Belt. Keep their ingredients in the same order as the recipe.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: A Touch of Brass
description: Info: Right-click a placed Stripped Oak Log with a Brass Ingot to make a Brass Casing. This forms the centre of your Brass Machine recipe.
Tip: A Deployer holding Brass Ingots can automate Casing production. This pack's Deployer recipe also accepts unstripped Logs.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Precision Built
description: Info: Surround a Brass Casing with 8 Precision Mechanisms in a Crafting Table to produce a Brass Machine.
This machine body supports your next workshop upgrades. Stonecutter conversions include Mechanical Arms and Rotation Speed Controllers, while other equipment uses it in crafting recipes.
Tip: Keep your Precision Mechanism assembly supplied. Expanding the workshop will give those Golden Sheets, Brass Sheets and Electron Tubes plenty more work to do.
quests.subtitle: Precision Machinery

quests.title: Chapter Completed
description:
You did it! Chapter 4 Completed!
Make sure to Unlock the Next Chapter in "The Story" Chapter
quests.subtitle: Unlock Next Chapter

quests.title: Getting Started
description: Info: Your workshop is ready to do a little thinking! This chapter introduces renewable Certus Quartz, Silicon production and processor assembly, finishing with the Calculation Machine and ME Controller.
Grow crystals using an Alchemical Laser and Water, then use Deployers and Mechanical Presses to manufacture your electronic components.
Tip: Search meteorites for your first AE2 processor presses. These reusable tools are held by Deployers during printing, so keep them safe when you find them.
quests.subtitle: Quest Information

quests.title: A Crystal Wrench in the Works
description: Info: Craft a Certus Quartz Wrench using five Certus Quartz Crystals. This tool is also used by a Deployer during Calculation Mechanism assembly.
Tip: The Wrench stays in the Deployer, but each assembled mechanism uses one durability. Keep an eye on it when running larger batches.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: A Dusty Discovery
description: Info: Collect your first Certus Quartz Crystals and process them in a Millstone to produce Certus Quartz Dust. This starting supply will help you establish renewable crystal production.
Hover over the Certus Quartz Dust in this quest's task and hold W to watch the Ponder explaining the growth process.
Tip: Prepare some Quartz Glass for your first Laser Emitter. Its crafting recipe combines five Quartz Dust with four Glass blocks to produce four Quartz Glass.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Sand at the Ready
description: Info: Your Sand supply has another job! Set some aside to combine with Certus Quartz Dust for Siliceous Compound, the starting material for Silicon.
Tip: Split this supply off before washing or smelting. Keep your existing Clay and Glass lines supplied as well.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Gold for Thought
description: Info: Set aside Gold Ingots for your Logic Processor production. Your Ochrum processing line can keep this branch supplied.
Tip: Feed this branch directly from your Ingot supply. Printing Logic Circuits uses Gold Ingots, while your Precision Mechanism line still needs Golden Sheets.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Room to Grow
description: Info: Craft a Growth Lens and fit it into an Alchemical Laser Emitter. Supply rotational power and align its beam with Certus Quartz Dust placed on a Depot.
The Growth Lens recipe uses four Polished Rose Quartz, two Precision Mechanisms, two Brass Sheets and a Moss Block. Your Emitter is built using a Brass Machine and optical components.
Tip: The Certus growth recipe requires at least 16 RPM. Hold W over the Certus Quartz Dust task item to see how to arrange the processing setup.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Sounds Logical
description: Info: Apply an Inscriber Logic Press to a Gold Ingot using a Deployer, then process the unfinished item beneath a Mechanical Press.
This produces 1 Printed Logic Circuit, with the Logic Press retained in the Deployer.
Tip: Search meteorites for your first Logic Press. Additional copies can be made from Iron Blocks using the original in a Deployer, followed by pressing.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Small Beginnings
description: Info: Process 1 Certus Quartz Dust using an Alchemical Laser fitted with a Growth Lens to produce 1 Small Certus Quartz Bud. This is the first stage of your growing crystal.
Tip: The following growth stages use Spouts and Water. Keep the Bud as an item so it can pass through those processing steps.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Just Add Water
description: Info: Apply Water to a Small Certus Quartz Bud using a Spout. It needs three separate applications of 100 mB to become a Medium Certus Quartz Bud.
Tip: You can use three Spouts in sequence or return the Bud beneath the same Spout for each operation. Simply supplying 300 mB does not replace the three processing steps.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Growing Pains
description: Info: Give your Medium Certus Quartz Bud another three Water applications of 100 mB each beneath Spouts. After the third application, it becomes a Large Certus Quartz Bud.
Tip: Each growth stage has its own three-step sequence. Keep unfinished Buds moving through the line until their current stage is complete.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Fully Grown!
description: Info: Process a Large Certus Quartz Bud with three more Water applications of 100 mB each to produce a Certus Quartz Cluster. Your crystal is ready for processing!
Tip: Growing one Small Bud all the way into a Cluster requires nine Water applications, using 900 mB in total.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Crystal Clear
description: Info: Feed a Certus Quartz Cluster between powered Crushing Wheels to produce 2–4 Certus Quartz Crystals. Two are guaranteed, with two separate 50% chances for an additional Crystal.
Tip: Split your Crystal output between circuit printing, tool crafting and Dust production. Returning some material to the growth line keeps the process supplied.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Calculated Impressions
description: Info: Place a Certus Quartz Crystal beneath a Deployer holding an Inscriber Calculation Press. Follow that operation with a Mechanical Press to produce 1 Printed Calculation Circuit.
Tip: The Calculation Press is reusable and stays in the Deployer. The Crystal is consumed, so keep this branch connected to your crystal production.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Back to Dust
description: Info: Process Certus Quartz Crystals using Crushing Wheels to produce 2 Certus Quartz Dust per Crystal, with a chance for an Experience Nugget.
A Millstone also produces Dust, but only one per Crystal.
Tip: Return part of this Dust to your Growth Lens setup and send the rest toward Silicon and Quartz Glass production. Your crystal-growing line can now supply its own starting material.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Mixed Results
description: Info: Combine 1 Sand and 1 Certus Quartz Dust in a Basin beneath a powered Mechanical Mixer to produce 1 Siliceous Compound.
This recipe requires a heated Basin, so place a fuelled Blaze Burner underneath it.
Tip: The compound must be smelted before it becomes Silicon. Keep its output heading toward a Furnace or blasting setup.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Silicon Valley
description: Info: Smelt Siliceous Compound into Silicon using a Furnace or Blast Furnace. Each compound produces one Silicon.
Tip: Both Calculation and Logic Processors need Printed Silicon, so this production line supplies two branches of your assembly.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Making an Impression
description: Info: Start with Silicon and perform these steps in order:

1. Use a Deployer holding an Inscriber Silicon Press.
2. Process the unfinished item beneath a Mechanical Press.
This produces 1 Printed Silicon. The Silicon Press remains in the Deployer for reuse.
Tip: Your first Silicon Press comes from meteorite loot. You can copy it by applying the original to an Iron Block with a Deployer, then finishing the copy beneath a Mechanical Press.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: A Calculated Decision
description: Info: Start with a Printed Calculation Circuit and complete this sequence:

1. Deploy one Redstone.
2. Deploy one Printed Silicon.
3. Finish with a Mechanical Press.
One complete pass produces 1 Calculation Processor.
Tip: Keep your reusable printing press in its earlier Deployer. This assembly stage consumes Redstone and Printed Silicon rather than applying the printing tool again.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: A Little Common Sense
description: Info: Start with a Printed Logic Circuit and perform these steps in order:

1. Deploy one Redstone.
2. Deploy one Printed Silicon.
3. Finish with a Mechanical Press.
One complete pass produces 1 Logic Processor.
Tip: Both processor branches share the same finishing ingredients. Split your Printed Silicon and Redstone supplies so neither branch runs dry.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Putting Two and Two Together
description: Info: Start with a Precision Mechanism and complete these assembly steps:

1. Deploy a Calculation Processor.
2. Deploy a Logic Processor.
3. Use a Certus Quartz Wrench in a Deployer.
4. Finish with a Mechanical Press.
One complete pass produces 1 Calculation Mechanism.
Tip: The processors are consumed, while the Wrench loses durability. Place the three Deployers directly beside one another above your Belt, followed by the Press.

prerequisites.title: A Crystal Wrench in the Works

quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Some Assembly Required
description: Info: Build a Calculation Machine in a Crafting Table using:

• Certus Quartz Dust in the centre.
• Four Calculation Mechanisms directly above, below, left and right of it.
• Four Quartz Glass in the corners.
Tip: This machine body is made before the ME Controller. Use a Stonecutter to convert the finished Calculation Machine into a Controller.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Taking Control
description: Info: Place your Calculation Machine in a Stonecutter to produce an ME Controller. This manages channels for your growing Applied Energistics network.
Your network needs power and connected devices to become useful. Storage is provided by equipment such as ME Drives and Storage Cells, with a Terminal giving you access to the contents.
Tip: Leave space around the Controller for cables and future expansion. Your factory's new brain will have plenty of connections to manage.
quests.subtitle: Logic & Energistics

quests.title: Chapter Completed
description: Info: You have finished this chapter! Mark this quest as completed, then head over to The Story and claim Chapter V | Completed to unlock Chapter VI — Light Engineering.
Tip: Keep your crystal and processor production running. Steel, wiring and a sturdier class of machinery are waiting just ahead!
quests.subtitle: Unlock Next Chapter

quests.title: Getting Started
description: Info: Time to give the workshop a sturdier backbone! This chapter brings together Steel, Electrum Wire and Electronic Components to produce the Reinforced Mechanism and Light Engineering Block.
Produce Coal Coke for Steel, put its Creosote byproduct to work treating wood and develop a renewable Silver supply for Electrum.
Tip: Several branches share materials. Your Electrum Wire supplies both Electronic Components and Reinforced Mechanisms, while Creosote connects Coke production to Treated Wood.
quests.subtitle: Quest Information

quests.title: Back to the Woods!
description: Info: Your Oak supply has another busy chapter ahead. Set aside Oak Logs for Charcoal production and send another portion toward Planks for Treated Wood.
Tip: Split the Logs before stripping and sawing them. Charcoal production needs whole Logs, while your Plank line can continue using the Mechanical Saw.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: An Unhealthy Harvest
description: Info: Gather Nether Wart and establish a renewable crop on Soul Sand. This unusual little plant starts your Cinder Flour and Silver production chain.
Tip: Harvest fully grown Wart and keep some aside for replanting. A steady crop gives your processing equipment something to work with.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Iron on Standby
description: Info: Set aside some Iron Ingots for Steel production. Your existing Gravel-washing and smelting line can keep this branch supplied.
Tip: Feed this branch before the Mechanical Press. Steel production starts with Iron Ingots, while your earlier electronic components still need Iron Sheets.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Wood You Believe It?
description: Info: Set aside some Oak Planks for treatment with Creosote. Your existing Mechanical Saw line can keep this branch supplied.
Tip: Take these Planks before they are cut into ordinary Slabs. Treat the full Planks first, then make Treated Wood Slabs from the result.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Going for Gold
description: Info: Your Gold supply has another customer! Set aside Gold Ingots to combine with Silver for Electrum production.
Tip: Split your Gold supply between this branch, Logic Circuits and Golden Sheets. Your earlier mechanism production still needs its share.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Quartz and All
description: Info: Set aside Nether Quartz for your Electronic Components. Your Soul Sand washing line can provide a renewable supply.
Tip: Use the Quartz directly for this recipe. Keep another portion flowing toward Rose Quartz so your earlier Electron Tube production remains supplied.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Red-y for Anything
description: Info: Gather some Redstone for Electronic Component production. Your Scoria milling line can keep it coming without another mining trip.
Tip: Your processors and Rose Quartz also need Redstone. Give each production branch a share rather than sending the entire supply into one recipe.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: A Dark Turn
description: Info: Smelt Oak Logs into Charcoal. This provides a renewable starting material for your Coal Coke production.
Tip: Keep some Charcoal available as fuel. Your Coke recipe uses eight Charcoal per operation, so give this branch a dependable supply.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Flour Power!
description: Info: Feed Nether Wart between powered Crushing Wheels to produce Cinder Flour. Each Wart produces one Flour, with a chance for an Experience Nugget.
Tip: Send the Flour toward an Alchemical Laser fitted with a Convergence Lens. That processing step turns it into Silver Dust.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Coke, No Ice
description: Info: Process 8 Charcoal in an Immersive Engineering Coke Oven to produce 1 Coal Coke and 500 mB of Creosote.
Build the Coke Oven using Coke Bricks and form the structure with an Engineer's Hammer. The Engineer's Manual shows its construction.
Tip: Extract the Creosote as well as the Coke. A full fluid tank stops further processing, and the Creosote is needed by your Treated Wood branch.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Converging Interests
description: Info: Craft a Convergence Lens and fit it into an Alchemical Laser Emitter. This lens allows the Laser to process Cinder Flour into Silver Dust.
Supply rotational power and align the beam with the Flour placed on a Depot.
Tip: Your earlier Laser setup can be reused by changing its lens. Give Silver production its own Emitter when you want crystal growth and material processing running together.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Waste Not, Want Not
description: Info: Collect the Creosote produced by your Coke Oven. This oily byproduct is used to turn ordinary Planks into Treated Wood.
Your Charcoal-to-Coke recipe produces 500 mB per operation. Two operations provide enough to fill one Bucket.
Tip: Store the fluid rather than disposing of it. Keeping Creosote moving out of the Oven supports both your Steel production and your Treated Wood supply.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Nerves of Steel
description: Info: Process Iron Ingots in an Immersive Engineering Blast Furnace using Coal Coke as fuel. Each Iron Ingot becomes a Steel Ingot, with Slag produced alongside it.
Use the Engineer's Manual to build the Blast Brick structure, then form it with an Engineer's Hammer.
Tip: This is Immersive Engineering's multiblock Blast Furnace. Keep both its Steel and Slag outputs clear so processing can continue.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: A Silver Lining
description: Info: Process 1 Cinder Flour using an Alchemical Laser fitted with a Convergence Lens to produce 1 Silver Dust. This recipe requires at least 16 RPM.
Tip: Collect the processed Dust and send it toward smelting. Keep the Depot clear so the next batch of Flour can enter the beam.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Steeling the Show
description: Info: Process Steel Ingots beneath a powered Mechanical Press to produce Steel Plates. Each Ingot produces one Plate.
Tip: Steel Plates are needed for both Reinforced Mechanisms and Light Engineering Blocks. Keep a buffer so one recipe does not consume the entire supply.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Treat Yourself!
description: Info: Surround a Creosote Bucket with 8 Oak Planks in a Crafting Table to produce 8 Treated Wood Planks. This uses 1,000 mB of Creosote.
Tip: The Creosote comes from your Coke Oven branch. Keep some Treated Wood as full blocks for Light Engineering Blocks and cut the rest into Slabs for Electronic Components.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Shiny Side Up
description: Info: Smelt your Silver Dust into Silver Ingots. These combine with Gold to produce Electrum for your wiring.
Tip: Keep the Silver in Ingot form for the mixing step. Your Electrum line needs equal numbers of Silver and Gold Ingots.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: A Cut Above
description: Info: Craft Treated Wood Planks into Treated Wood Slabs. Three Planks arranged in a row produce six Slabs.
These form the wooden base of your Electronic Components.
Tip: Keep ordinary Oak Slabs and Treated Wood Slabs in separate supplies. The component recipe specifically needs Treated Wood.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Better Together
description: Info: Combine 1 Silver Ingot and 1 Gold Ingot in a Basin beneath a powered Mechanical Mixer to produce 2 Electrum Ingots.
This recipe requires heat, so place a fuelled Blaze Burner beneath the Basin.
Tip: Keep both ingredients supplied evenly. A Basin full of only Gold or Silver leaves no room for its missing partner.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Thinly Spread
description: Info: Place Electrum Ingots beneath a powered Mechanical Press to make Electrum Plates. Each Ingot produces one Plate.
Tip: Send these Plates toward a Rolling Mill. The wire recipe uses Plates as its starting material.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Live Wire!
description: Info: Process Electrum Plates using a powered Rolling Mill to produce 2 Electrum Wire per Plate. You can make the Rolling Mill by converting a Brass Machine in a Stonecutter.
Tip: Split this output between Electronic Components and Reinforced Mechanisms. Both recipes consume Wire, so completing one branch does not remove the other branch's material cost.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: A Little More Sophisticated
description: Info: Use a two-by-two arrangement of powered Mechanical Crafters to assemble one Electronic Component:

• Top left: one Treated Wood Slab.
• Top right: one Nether Quartz.
• Bottom left: one Redstone.
• Bottom right: one Electrum Wire.
Tip: Set the Crafter arrows so all ingredients join and exit through the intended output. These components supply both Reinforced Mechanisms and Light Engineering Blocks.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Built to Last
description: Info: Start with a Calculation Mechanism and complete these assembly steps in order:

1. Deploy one Electrum Wire.
2. Deploy one Electronic Component.
3. Deploy one Steel Plate.
4. Finish with a Mechanical Press.
One complete pass produces 1 Reinforced Mechanism.
Tip: The Electronic Component already contains Electrum Wire, and this assembly consumes another Wire directly. Keep both supply branches running.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Engineering Degree
description: Info: Craft a Light Engineering Block using the following arrangement:

• Four Steel Plates in the corners.
• Treated Wood Planks at the top and bottom centre.
• Reinforced Mechanisms at the left and right centre.
• One Electronic Component in the centre.
Tip: Each block needs two Reinforced Mechanisms plus an additional Electronic Component. Keep spare components and Steel Plates available for construction.
quests.subtitle: Light Engineering

quests.title: Chapter Completed
description: Info: You have finished this chapter! Mark this quest as completed, then head over to The Story and claim Chapter VI | Completed to unlock Chapter VII — Heavy Machines.
Tip: Keep your Steel, wiring and Electronic Component production running. Your next projects will give the workshop plenty of reasons to expand!
quests.subtitle: Unlock Next Chapter

quests.title: Getting Started
description: Info: The workshop is getting serious! This chapter brings together Aluminium, Nickel, wiring and advanced electronics to produce the Industrial Mechanism and Heavy Engineering Machine.
Develop your metal supplies, manufacture Electron Tubes and reinforce your machinery for larger industrial projects.
Tip: Obtain your first Aluminium and Nickel through mining. Once your Heavy Engineering Machine allows you to build the Crusher, Crying Obsidian can supply both metals renewably.
quests.subtitle: Quest Information

quests.title: Crimson Industry
description: Info: Grow a Huge Crimson Fungus and position a powered Rubberworks Sapper facing its Crimson Stem. With the matching Nether Wart Blocks present, this provides a renewable source of Lava.
Tip: Leave the grown fungus intact for the Sapper. A decorative Stem placed on its own does not provide the complete tree arrangement needed for extraction.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Just Add Water… Again
description: Info: Prepare a Water Bucket for Obsidian production. Flowing Water turns a Lava source block into Obsidian when the two meet.
Tip: Build a small renewable Water supply near your processing area. Your washing, crystal-growing and fluid-processing equipment can all benefit from it.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: A Copper Contribution
description: Info: Set aside Copper Ingots for Steel Mechanical Components. Your Veridium processing line can keep these supplied.
Tip: Take this supply before the Press. Mechanical Components use Copper Ingots, while your Wire branch starts with Copper Sheets.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Steel Yourself
description: Info: Keep your Steel production running and press the Ingots into Steel Plates. These supply mechanical components, Industrial Mechanisms and your final machine construction.
Tip: This chapter uses Steel Plates in several places. Give the output a buffer before splitting it between assembly and construction.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Back for Another Bounce
description: Info: Prepare some Rubber from your existing Resin production line. Each Advanced Electronic Component starts with one piece of cured Rubber.
Tip: Check that the Raw Rubber has passed through smoking before entering this assembly. Keep your Belt Connector and Sealed Mechanism supplies fed as well.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: A Turn of the Screw
description: Info: Craft an Engineer's Screwdriver using an Iron Rod and a Stick. A Deployer uses this tool during Industrial Mechanism assembly.
Tip: The Screwdriver remains in the Deployer, but each completed mechanism uses one durability. Keep a replacement nearby for longer production runs.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Redstone, Revisited
description: Info: Gather Redstone for your Electron Tube production. Your Scoria milling line can provide a renewable supply.
Tip: Your processors and earlier Electronic Components still need Redstone. Split the supply so this new branch does not leave the others waiting.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Clearly Needed
description: Info: Set aside Glass for your new Electron Tubes. Your existing Sand-smelting or fan-blasting line can keep this branch supplied.
Tip: Use full Glass blocks for the crafting recipe. Keep some available for your earlier Sealed Mechanism production as well.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Copper Under Pressure
description: Info: Press Copper Ingots into Copper Sheets using a powered Mechanical Press. These Sheets are the starting material for Copper Wire.
Tip: Split your pressed Sheets between Wire production and your existing Sealed Mechanism assembly.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Some Like It Hot
description: Info: Collect Lava from your Crimson Sapper setup, or gather a starting supply from the world. Pump the Sapper's fluid output from its back connection into storage.
Tip: Obsidian production consumes Lava source blocks. Keep a fluid reserve so producing one batch does not empty the supply needed elsewhere in your workshop.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Gears of Industry
description: Info: Use three powered Mechanical Crafters in a horizontal row. Place a Steel Plate in each of the first two Crafters and a Copper Ingot in the third.
Combining 2 Steel Plates and 1 Copper Ingot produces 1 Steel Mechanical Component.
Tip: Set the Crafter arrows so the ingredients join and leave through your chosen output. Keep spare Components for the Heavy Engineering Machine itself.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Getting Wound Up
description: Info: Process Copper Sheets using a powered Rolling Mill to produce Copper Wire. Each Sheet produces two Wire.
Tip: This branch supplies the Copper Wire used inside your IE Electron Tubes. Keep it separate from Aluminium and Electrum Wire when feeding the Crafters.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: A Rocky Relationship
description: Info: Bring Water into contact with a Lava source block to create Obsidian, then collect the block for further processing.
Tip: This uses up the Lava source. Your earlier Cobblestone generators preserve their Lava, so an Obsidian setup needs a way to replenish it.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: No Use Crying Over Obsidian
description: Info: Haunt Obsidian using an Encased Fan blowing through Soul Fire or a lit Soul Campfire. Place the Obsidian in the airflow beyond the fire to turn it into Crying Obsidian.
Tip: Once your IE Crusher is available, this material provides both Aluminium Dust and Nickel Dust from the same processing operation.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Crushing Expectations
description: Info: Build and power an Immersive Engineering Crusher, then feed it Crying Obsidian. Each block produces 1 Aluminium Dust and 1 Nickel Dust.
Smelt the Aluminium Dust into Ingots to feed your Wire production.
Tip: The Crusher needs electrical power. Collect and sort both outputs so your Aluminium and Nickel processing lines can run together.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Every Nickel Counts
description: Info: Collect the Nickel Dust produced when Crying Obsidian passes through your IE Crusher. Each block guarantees one Nickel Dust alongside one Aluminium Dust.
Smelt the Dust into Nickel Ingots, then use a Mechanical Press to turn those Ingots into Nickel Plates.
Tip: Both Dusts come from the same crushing operation. One Crying Obsidian supplies both branches, so split the output before sending each material toward smelting.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: A Lighter Workload
description: Info: Obtain your first Aluminium Ingots from mined resources. Later, your Crying Obsidian processing line supplies Aluminium Dust that can be smelted into more Ingots.
Tip: Keep some Aluminium in Ingot form. This chapter's Aluminium Wire recipe feeds Ingots directly into a Rolling Mill.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: A Nickel for Your Thoughts
description: Info: Smelt Nickel Dust into Nickel Ingots. Each Dust produces one Ingot, ready to be pressed into Nickel Plates for your Electron Tubes.
Tip: An Encased Fan blowing through Lava can bulk-blast the Dust. Place it in the airflow beyond the Lava, then send the finished Ingots toward your Mechanical Press.

quests.title: A Thin Excuse
description: Info: Process Aluminium Ingots beneath a powered Mechanical Press to produce Aluminium Plates. Each Ingot produces one Plate.
Tip: Keep Plates and Ingots in separate supplies. The current Aluminium Wire recipe uses Ingots directly, unlike your Copper and Electrum Wire routes.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Nickel and Dime
description: Info: Smelt your Nickel resources into Nickel Ingots, then process the Ingots beneath a Mechanical Press to make Nickel Plates.
Start with mined Nickel. Your later Crying Obsidian route provides a renewable Dust supply for the same smelting and pressing steps.
Tip: Each Electron Tube crafting batch needs one Nickel Plate. Keep these feeding your electronic component production.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Wired for Industry
description: Info: Feed Aluminium Ingots into a powered Rolling Mill to produce 2 Aluminium Wire per Ingot. This supplies your Advanced Electronic Component assembly.
Tip: Give the Rolling Mill a buffer of Ingots and keep its output clear. Each Advanced Electronic Component consumes one Aluminium Wire.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Vacuum Packed!
description: Info: Use a two-by-two arrangement of powered Mechanical Crafters with these ingredients:

• Top left: one Glass block.
• Top right: one Nickel Plate.
• Bottom left: one Copper Wire.
• Bottom right: one Redstone.
One batch produces 3 Immersive Engineering Electron Tubes.
Tip: Check the mod name when selecting ingredients. This assembly uses Immersive Engineering's glass Electron Tubes; your earlier Create Electron Tubes serve different recipes.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: An Advanced Understanding
description: Info: Start with 1 Rubber and complete these assembly steps:

1. Deploy an IE Electron Tube.
2. Deploy another IE Electron Tube.
3. Deploy an Aluminium Wire.
4. Finish with a Mechanical Press.
One complete pass produces 1 Advanced Electronic Component.
Tip: The two Tube operations consume two separate Tubes. Supply both Deployers before starting a batch.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Industrial Strength
description: Info: Start with a Reinforced Mechanism and complete these assembly steps in order:

1. Deploy a Steel Plate.
2. Deploy an Advanced Electronic Component.
3. Deploy a Steel Mechanical Component.
4. Use an Engineer's Screwdriver in a Deployer.
5. Finish with a Mechanical Press.
One complete pass produces 1 Industrial Mechanism.
Tip: The Screwdriver is the reusable tool in this sequence. The Plate and both Components are consumed.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Heavy Duty
description: Info: First craft a Heavy Engineering Block with four Steel Plates in the corners, Treated Wood at the top and bottom centre, Industrial Mechanisms at the left and right centre, and an Electronic Component in the middle.
Then use a three-by-three arrangement of Mechanical Crafters to build the Heavy Engineering Machine:

• Four Steel Plates in the corners.
• A Steel Mechanical Component at the top centre.
• Industrial Mechanisms at the left and right centre.
• The Heavy Engineering Block in the middle.
• An Advanced Electronic Component at the bottom centre.
Tip: The finished machine is a construction component for larger industrial equipment. Check each multiblock's required materials before committing your entire mechanism supply.
quests.subtitle: Heavy Machines

quests.title: Chapter Completed
description: Info: You have finished this chapter! Mark this quest as completed, then head over to The Story and claim Chapter VII | Completed to unlock Chapter VIII — Magic & Mana.
Tip: Keep your Industrial Mechanisms and advanced electronics in production. Your factory is about to receive a little magical assistance!
quests.subtitle: Unlock Next Chapter

quests.title: Getting Started
description: Info: The factory could use a little magic! This chapter brings together growing Amethyst, Arcane Essence, liquid Mana and Dragon's Breath to assemble the Arcane Mechanism.
Your existing machines still do much of the work, but some new ingredients will need a more magical approach.
Tip: Liquid Mana, Ars Nouveau Source and spellcasting mana are separate resources. Your dedicated magic questlines can help with the magical systems used alongside this chapter.
quests.subtitle: Quest Information

quests.title: A Shard of Potential
description: Info: Gather your first Amethyst Shards from fully grown Amethyst Clusters. These provide the starting material for a renewable growing line.
Process a Shard using an Alchemical Laser fitted with a Growth Lens to create a Small Amethyst Bud.
Tip: Hover over the Amethyst Shard in this quest's task and hold W to view its Ponder guidance. Your earlier Certus-growing experience will come in handy here.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Heads Up!
description: Info: Bring home a Dragon Head from an End Ship. Create: Dragons Plus allows it to turn an Encased Fan's airflow into Dragon's Breath processing.
Place the Head in the airflow with its mouth pointing in the same direction the air is travelling, away from the Fan.
Tip: Hover over the Dragon Head in this quest's task and hold W to see the Ponder setup. Alignment matters: the Head must face along the airflow.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Bottling Opportunity
description: Info: Craft Glass Bottles for collecting Dragon's Breath. Three Glass blocks arranged in a V produce three Bottles.
Place the Bottles in the processed airflow beyond your aligned Dragon Head.
Tip: The Bottles are returned when their contents pass through an Item Drain. Send those empties back to the Fan setup to reuse them.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Berry Interesting
description: Info: Gather Sourceberries from Ars Nouveau's Sourceberry Bushes. Combine them with Twisting Vines to begin your renewable Lapis production.
Tip: Keep a few bushes planted near your base. Harvesting the berries gives you a continuing supply without removing the plants.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: A Twisted Beginning
description: Info: Gather Twisting Vines from the Nether's Warped Forests. These blue-green vines are one of the ingredients used to make Ward Blend.
Tip: Keep a planted supply near your workshop and use Bone Meal to encourage growth. Twisting Vines grow upward, so leave room above them.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Back in Black
description: Info: Set aside some Obsidian for Sturdy Sheet production. This branch sends ordinary Obsidian directly toward Crushing Wheels.
Tip: Split this supply before haunting. Your earlier Aluminium and Nickel production uses Crying Obsidian, while this recipe starts with ordinary Obsidian.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Hot Stuff, Coming Through
description: Info: Supply Lava to a Spout for Sturdy Sheet production. Each Sheet consumes 500 mB, so one Bucket supplies two Sheets.
Tip: Your Crimson Sapper setup can provide a renewable supply. Keep enough storage to support both Obsidian generation and this filling step.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Experience Required
description: Info: Collect Nuggets of Experience from your processing lines. Several of this pack's Crushing Wheel recipes can produce them, including Amethyst Cluster processing.
Each Arcane Essence consumes one Nugget.
Tip: Keep a buffer of these byproducts for manufacturing. The relevant crushing recipes award them by chance, so production will not always be even.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Another Sheet, Another Job
description: Info: Process Iron Ingots beneath a powered Mechanical Press to make Iron Sheets. Each Empty Tube starts with one Sheet.
Tip: Feed the finished Sheets toward a Deployer holding Iron Ingots. A Depot works for your first batches, while a Belt can connect the steps for automation.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Clearly Magical
description: Info: Prepare some Glass for your magical workshop. Smelt Sand in a Furnace, or bulk-blast it using an Encased Fan blowing through Lava.
Tip: Keep a supply of full Glass blocks alongside your Bottles. Your existing Sand-processing line can keep both stocked as production grows.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Budding Ambitions
description: Info: Process 1 Amethyst Shard using an Alchemical Laser fitted with a Growth Lens to produce 1 Small Amethyst Bud. This recipe requires at least 16 RPM.
Tip: Keep the Bud as an item for the following processing stages. Spouts will apply the Water needed to grow it into a full Cluster.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Take a Deep Breath
description: Info: Process Glass Bottles in the airflow beyond a correctly aligned Dragon Head to produce Dragon's Breath Bottles.
Tip: Keep the Bottles on a Depot or moving through the processed airflow on a Belt. Then route the filled Bottles toward an Item Drain.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: A Strange Little Salad
description: Info: Combine 1 Twisting Vine and 1 Sourceberry in a crafting grid to produce 1 Ward Blend. The recipe is shapeless.
Tip: Send the finished blend toward a haunting setup. A little Soul Fire gives this unusual mixture a rather more useful result.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: A Tough Grind
description: Info: Process Obsidian between powered Crushing Wheels to produce Powdered Obsidian. Each operation produces one Powder, with a 75% chance to return the Obsidian and a chance for a Nugget of Experience.
Tip: Return recovered Obsidian to the input and send the Powder toward Sturdy Sheet assembly. Recycling the returned blocks reduces your fresh Obsidian demand.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: An Empty Promise
description: Info: Fill an Empty Tube with 300 mB of liquid Mana using a Spout to produce 1 Mana Tube.
Tip: Keep the Tube filling line supplied from your Mana tank. Each Arcane Mechanism consumes one finished Mana Tube.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: A Growing Interest
description: Info: Apply Water to a Small Amethyst Bud using Spouts. It needs three separate applications of 100 mB to become a Medium Amethyst Bud.
Tip: Use three Spouts in sequence or return the Bud beneath the same Spout for each operation. The recipe tracks three processing steps, rather than one larger pour.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Breath on Tap
description: Info: Run Dragon's Breath Bottles over an Item Drain to collect their contents as fluid. Each Bottle provides 250 mB of Dragon's Breath and returns an empty Glass Bottle.
Four Bottles provide enough fluid to fill one Bucket.
Tip: Each Arcane Mechanism needs 400 mB of Dragon's Breath. Use a tank to buffer the fluid, then pipe it to the first Spout in your assembly line.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Made of Sterner Stuff
description: Info: Start with Powdered Obsidian and complete these assembly steps:

1. Apply 500 mB of Lava using a Spout.
2. Process it beneath a Mechanical Press.
3. Press it a second time.
This produces 1 Sturdy Sheet.
Tip: Both pressing operations must happen. Use two Presses in sequence or return the unfinished item beneath the same Press.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Feeling Blue Again
description: Info: Haunt Ward Blend using an Encased Fan blowing through Soul Fire or a lit Soul Campfire. Each blend produces 1 Lapis Lazuli.
Tip: Place the blend in the airflow beyond the fire. Keep some Lapis aside for enchanting and other recipes while supplying your Arcane Essence line.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Bigger Things Ahead
description: Info: Give your Medium Amethyst Bud another three Water applications of 100 mB each to produce a Large Amethyst Bud.
Tip: Each stage has its own three-step sequence. Keep the item moving through the line until the current growth stage finishes.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: In Full Bloom
description: Info: Apply Water to your Large Amethyst Bud three more times, using 100 mB per application. The finished result is an Amethyst Cluster, ready for crushing.
Tip: The complete growing line uses nine separate Water applications, consuming 900 mB from Small Bud to finished Cluster.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Shards for Days
description: Info: Feed an Amethyst Cluster between powered Crushing Wheels to produce 2–4 Amethyst Shards, with a chance for a Nugget of Experience.
Two Shards are guaranteed, with two separate 50% chances for an additional Shard.
Tip: Return part of the output to your Growth Lens setup. The remaining Shards can supply Arcane Essence and Source Gem production.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Consider the Source
description: Info: Use an Ars Nouveau Imbuement Chamber to turn an Amethyst Shard into a Source Gem. Lapis Lazuli can also be used as the input for a Source Gem.
For batch processing, imbue an Amethyst Block into a Source Gem Block, then unpack it into four Source Gems.
Tip: Your Ars Nouveau questline covers Imbuement and Source generation in more detail. Keep these Gems feeding your Arcane Mechanism assembly.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: A Certain Essence
description: Info: Combine these ingredients in a Basin beneath a powered Mechanical Mixer:

• 1 Lapis Lazuli.
• 1 Amethyst Shard.
• 1 Nugget of Experience.
This produces 1 Arcane Essence and requires superheating. Feed a Blaze Burner a Blaze Cake to reach the required temperature.
Tip: Ordinary heated mixing is insufficient. Check the Burner's heat level before troubleshooting the ingredients or Mixer.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Going with the Mana Flow
description: Info: Mix 1 Arcane Essence with 250 mB of Water in a Basin beneath a Mechanical Mixer to produce 250 mB of liquid Mana. No heat is required.
Four batches provide 1,000 mB, enough to fill a Bucket.
Tip: Each Mana Tube needs 300 mB. Use a fluid buffer between mixing and filling, since one Essence batch produces slightly less than a Tube requires.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Mana in a Bottle… Almost
description: Info: Fill an Empty Tube with 300 mB of liquid Mana using a Spout to produce 1 Mana Tube.
Tip: Keep the Tube filling line supplied from your Mana tank. Each Arcane Mechanism consumes one finished Mana Tube.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: A Touch of the Arcane
description: Info: Start with an Industrial Mechanism and complete these assembly steps in order:

1. Apply 400 mB of Dragon's Breath using a Spout.
2. Deploy a Source Gem.
3. Deploy a Sturdy Sheet.
4. Deploy a Mana Tube.
One complete pass produces 1 Arcane Mechanism. The final deployment completes it; no additional pressing step is required.
Tip: Place the Spout first, followed by three adjacent Deployers. Keep Dragon's Breath supplied to the Spout and the three solid ingredients in recipe order.
quests.subtitle: Magic & Mana

quests.title: Chapter Completed
description: Info: You have finished this chapter! Mark this quest as completed, then head over to The Story and claim Chapter VIII | Completed to unlock Chapter IX — Radiant & Shadow.
Tip: Keep your Mana Tubes, Source Gems and Arcane Mechanisms in production. The next chapter brings light and shadow into your growing workshop!
quests.subtitle: Unlock Next Chapter

quests.title: Getting Started
description: Info: Your factory is about to get a little stranger. Turn Singularities into Paintballs, collect their Ink, and combine Refined Radiance with Shadow Steel to produce the Eclipse Mechanism.
Tip: Several branches share ingredients. Split their outputs between the different production lines, and reserve enough material to keep your resource loops running.
quests.subtitle: Quest Information

quests.title: A Pinch of Ender
description: Info: Crush an Ender Pearl to obtain 2 Ender Dust. This first batch starts your renewable Ender Pearl production.
Tip: Keep some starting Dust available for the laser step before sending any into Singularity production.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Wart Could Go Wrong?
description: Info: Grow Nether Wart for Cinder Flour production and potion brewing. Both branches need a renewable supply.
Tip: Nether Wart grows on Soul Sand without water. Mechanical Harvesters can collect mature crops, allowing you to supply both branches from one farm.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Crushing the Crusher
description: Info: Set up production of Crushing Wheels as a consumable ingredient. These wheels will themselves be crushed to produce Singularities.
Tip: Keep the wheels operating your machinery separate from the wheels being sent through it!
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Dye Another Day
description: Info: Set up a renewable supply of Dye for your Dye Entangled Singularities. Any dye works, so choose a production method that suits your factory. Each Singularity consumes 8 dyes.

Tip: A Deployer applying Bone Meal to a tall flower, such as a Rose Bush, produces more flowers to turn into dye. Farming Turmeric or Sourceberries provides other renewable options, with Sourceberries crafting directly into Purple Dye. Check JEI for the available processing recipes!
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Pocket Sand!
description: Info: Supply Sand for TNT production. Each crafting operation consumes four pieces.
Tip: Branch off your existing Sand production and buffer it beside the Mechanical Crafters.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Wither or Without You
description: Info: Summon and defeat the Wither to obtain a Nether Star for your Beacon. Build its summoning shape from four Soul Sand or Soul Soil blocks and place three Wither Skeleton Skulls across the top.
Tip: Prepare a fighting area away from your factory. The Wither creates an explosion after charging up, so give it space and wait for that opening phase to finish.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Back to the Source
description: Info: Bring Source Gems from your existing production into this chapter. Their magical properties will become part of your Spectral Rubies.
Tip: Give this branch its own buffer so it can operate without consuming every Source Gem needed elsewhere in your factory.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Pretty in Pink
description: Info: Supply Rose Quartz for Spectral Ruby production. The next recipe uses one Rose Quartz for every Source Gem.
Tip: Use unpolished Rose Quartz here. The polishing step comes after it has been turned into a Spectral Ruby.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Flint and Finances
description: Info: Bring Flint into your Conduit Channeling line to supply renewable Prismarine Shards.
Tip: Your Gravel washing line can supply Flint. Sort it from the other outputs and keep a generous buffer for the chance-based Shard recipe.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: A Little Room for Magic
description: Info: Produce Empty Tubes by using a Deployer to apply an Iron Ingot to an Iron Sheet. These are the empty containers used in your Mana Tube production.

Tip: Check the exact tube requested by each recipe. The Spectral Ruby Electron Tube recipe uses an Iron Tube, crafted with an Iron Sheet above a Glass block in two vertically arranged Mechanical Crafters.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Ocean Power
description: Info: Activate a Conduit underwater inside a valid Prismarine frame. Air blown through its powered waters can perform Conduit Channeling, allowing you to process Flint and Glowstone Dust into Prismarine materials.
Tip: Hold W over the Conduit to view its Ponder. Follow the water layout carefully: extra layers of water can turn the setup into ordinary washing instead of Channeling.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Another Pinch of Flour
description: Info: Supply Cinder Flour from your Nether Wart crushing line to the Glowstone Dust branch. Each piece will be processed with Night Vision potion.
Tip: Split the Cinder Flour output between Gunpowder and Glowstone production, with a separate buffer for each branch.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: A Golden Garnish
description: Info: Supply Gold Nuggets for Golden Carrots. Each Carrot needs eight Nuggets.
Tip: Convert Gold Ingots into Nuggets near the crafting line and keep the input buffered to support continuous brewing.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Eat Your Vegetables
description: Info: Grow Carrots for your Golden Carrot production. These eventually become the brewing ingredient for Night Vision.
Tip: Mechanical Harvesters can collect mature Carrots. Supply the crafting line from a buffer and keep some available for expanding the farm.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: The Pearl Printer
description: Info: Process 1 Ender Dust with an Alchemical Laser fitted with a Convergence Lens to produce an Ender Pearl.
Tip: Send the Pearl back to your Crushing Wheels. Each one produces two Dust, allowing the loop to recover its starting ingredient and export the surplus.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Flour with a Temper
description: Info: Process Nether Wart between Crushing Wheels to produce Cinder Flour. This supplies your Gunpowder production.
Tip: Keep a buffer between the farm and the crushing line. Split off some Cinder Flour for the Glowstone Dust branch as well.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: A Slightly Smaller Wheel
description: Info: Feed a Crushing Wheel through another pair of Crushing Wheels to produce 1 Singularity. Apparently, the solution was more crushing.
Tip: Buffer the Singularities before combining them with TNT and Ender Dust so the Mixer has a consistent supply.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Let There Be Light!
description: Info: Craft a Beacon using your Nether Star, then activate it with a valid mineral base and a clear beam. Its beam converts dropped Chromatic Compound into Refined Radiance.
Tip: A single-layer Beacon base is sufficient for the beam. Leave space above it for the conversion area and a collection system.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: A Gem of an Idea
description: Info: Craft 1 Source Gem with 1 Rose Quartz to produce a Spectral Ruby. This is a shapeless crafting recipe.
Tip: Supply both ingredients in equal amounts and send the finished Rubies straight to your polishing station.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Something Fishy
description: Info: Process Flint with Conduit Channeling for a 33% chance to produce a Prismarine Shard per Flint.
Tip: Supply more Flint than your desired Shard output and buffer the results. Small batches can vary considerably because of the random yield.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Sea the Light
description: Info: Process Glowstone Dust with Conduit Channeling to produce Prismarine Crystals. Each Glowstone Dust becomes one Crystal.
Tip: Supply Glowstone Dust from the Spout line and collect the finished Crystals for Sea Lantern crafting.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Expensive Taste
description: Info: Surround a Carrot with 8 Gold Nuggets to craft a Golden Carrot. Feed the result into your potion brewing line.
Tip: Give brewing priority before sending spare Golden Carrots to food storage. Your factory needs its vegetables too!
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Double or Nothing
description: Info: Crush your manufactured Ender Pearls into Ender Dust. Return one Dust per Pearl to the laser and export the other as your net production.
Tip: Prioritize the laser's input buffer. Exporting every piece of Dust will eventually stop the loop.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: More Bang for Your Buck
description: Info: Mix 1 Cinder Flour with 1 Gunpowder in a Basin to produce 2 Gunpowder. The recipe does not require heat.
Tip: Find some starting Gunpowder, then return half the output to the Mixer and export the surplus. Prioritize the return path so your loop never runs empty.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Shine Bright Like a Ruby
description: Info: Polish a Spectral Ruby with Sand Paper to produce a Polished Spectral Ruby. A Deployer holding Sand Paper can automate this process.
Tip: Sand Paper wears out as it is used. Supply replacements to the Deployer and filter the output for polished Rubies.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow
