quests.title: Bottled Ocean Glow
description: Info: Craft a Sea Lantern using 4 Prismarine Shards in the corners and 5 Prismarine Crystals filling the remaining slots.
Tip: Balance the inputs around four Shards and five Crystals per Lantern, while allowing extra Flint processing capacity for its chance-based output.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: I Can See Clearly Now
description: Info: Use heated Basin mixing to brew Water with Nether Wart into Awkward Potion, then add Golden Carrots to produce Night Vision potion fluid.
Tip: Use separate Basins for the two brewing stages. Keep the regular Night Vision potion for the Glowstone recipe rather than extending its duration. Fill a potion bucket to complete this task.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Handle with Enthusiasm
description: Info: Use a 3 × 3 Mechanical Crafter setup to combine 5 Gunpowder and 4 Sand into TNT. Alternate the ingredients, placing Gunpowder in the corners and centre.
Tip: Filter the Crafter inputs to preserve the pattern. Your TNT will be consumed in a Basin further along the production line.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Now That's a Bright Idea
description: Info: Use a Deployer holding a Polished Spectral Ruby on an Iron Tube to produce a Polished Spectral Ruby Electron Tube.
Tip: The Iron Tube travels along the processing line while the Deployer supplies the Ruby. Each operation consumes one of each. Check JEI for the correct tube ingredient.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Liquid Nightlight
description: Info: Use a Spout to apply 25 mB of Night Vision potion to Cinder Flour, producing 1 Glowstone Dust per operation.
Tip: Send the Glowstone Dust directly into your Prismarine Crystal production. Keep it in dust form for that processing step.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: It's Complicated
description: Info: Mix 1 TNT, 1 Singularity and 1 Ender Dust to produce 2 Quantum Entangled Singularities. The Basin does not require heat.
Tip: Send the outputs into your dye crafting line. Leave space in the output buffer for both Singularities from each operation.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Colour Theory Gone Wrong
description: Info: Surround a Quantum Entangled Singularity with 8 dyes of any colour to produce a Dye Entangled Singularity. Crush the result to obtain Paintballs.
Tip: You can mix different dyes in the recipe. The dye colour does not determine the Paintball output, so use whichever dye is easiest to automate.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: A Splash of Colour
description: Info: Crushing a Dye Entangled Singularity produces one randomly selected Red, Green, Yellow, Blue or Purple Paintball. Collect the Red, Green, Yellow and Blue varieties shown in the tasks, then process them through Item Drains to collect Uncommon Ink.
Tip: Each draining step advances the colour:
Red → Green → Yellow → Blue → Purple
Feed each colour into the appropriate stage and collect Purple before it reaches another drain.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Purple Reign
description: Info: Collect Purple Paintballs for Chromatic Compound production. These can come directly from crushing or from draining the other Paintball colours.
Tip: Draining Purple produces Gray Paintballs and more Ink. Reserve enough Purple for your compound recipe before diverting any surplus to this extra step.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Ink Outside the Box
description: Info: Collect the Uncommon Ink released by your Paintball drains. Each draining step produces 10 mB, while each Eclipse Mechanism consumes 200 mB.
Tip: Pump the fluid into a shared tank feeding the assembly Spout. Keep storage available so full drains cannot stall your Paintball production. This task requests the bottled Ink item.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Taste the Entire Factory
description: Info: Combine 4 Purple Paintballs in a 2 × 2 Mechanical Crafter setup to produce Chromatic Compound. This supplies both the Radiant and Shadow branches.
Tip: Split the output between your Beacon conversion and Alchemical Laser. Both branches are needed for Eclipse Mechanisms.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Walking on Sunshine
description: Info: Drop Chromatic Compound into an active Beacon beam to transform it into Refined Radiance. This conversion happens to the dropped item in the world.
Tip: Refined Radiance floats upward. Enclose the conversion area and position your collection system where the finished material rises.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Bringing It All Together
description: Info: Fit an Alchemical Laser with a Convergence Lens for Ender Pearl and Shadow Steel production. Both processing recipes use this lens.
Tip: The lens is reusable. Dedicated laser setups let both production lines run continuously without swapping their inputs.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Flatten the Sunshine
description: Info: Process Refined Radiance with a Mechanical Press to produce a Radiant Sheet. Each piece of Radiance produces one Sheet.
Tip: Collect the Radiance into an inventory before feeding the Press so its floating behaviour cannot carry it away from the processing line.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Hello Darkness, My Old Friend
description: Info: Process Chromatic Compound with an Alchemical Laser fitted with a Convergence Lens to produce Shadow Steel.
Tip: Reserve a separate share of Chromatic Compound for this branch so your Beacon conversion cannot consume it all.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Coiled Sunshine
description: Info: Feed a Radiant Sheet into a single Mechanical Crafter to produce a Radiant Coil.
Tip: Each Eclipse Mechanism consumes two Radiant Coils. Supply enough for both Coil Deployers in the final assembly line.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: A Light in the Dark
description: Info: Combine 1 Shadow Steel and 1 Sea Lantern in a heated Basin to produce Refined Shadow Alloy.
Tip: Keep the Blaze Burner supplied and buffer both ingredients. Each Eclipse Mechanism consumes one Refined Shadow Alloy.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: A Total Eclipse of the Parts
description: Info: Start with an Arcane Mechanism and process it through this sequence:

1. Deploy a Radiant Coil.
2. Deploy a second Radiant Coil.
3. Deploy a Refined Shadow Alloy.
4. Deploy a Polished Spectral Ruby Electron Tube.
5. Apply 200 mB of Uncommon Ink with a Spout.
6. Finish with a Mechanical Press.
Tip: The sequence runs once. Supply both Coil Deployers separately, keep the Spout filled, and filter the output for finished Eclipse Mechanisms.
quests.subtitle: Radiant & Shadow

quests.title: Chapter Completed
description: Info: Light and shadow now work together in your factory. With Eclipse Mechanisms in production, you are ready to take on the final chapter.
Tip: Mark this quest as completed, then open The Story and claim Chapter IX | Completed to unlock Chapter X — The Final Chapter.
